final: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT e.type AS event_type, AVG(1.0 * b.spent / b.amount) AS average_ratio FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE b.spent IS NOT NULL AND b.amount IS NOT NULL AND b.amount <> 0 GROUP BY e.type) SELECT event_type, average_ratio, average_ratio - AVG(average_ratio) OVER () AS difference_from_mean FROM type_averages
